text:
Emma: Quick follow-up on yesterday's cloud-provider + model-registry outage postmortem. Summarizing actions & owners; pinging folks for ETAs. TL;DR: three remediation streams (failover, vendor logs access, customer comms), two blockers (vendor log access, RBAC for model-registry read). I'll drop the action list below.

Emma: ACTIONS:
1) Giorgio - run full failover drill for region-az1 -> az3, measure cold-start latency and document runbook gaps. Due: 2026-04-02. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4721
2) Anya - add model-registry read-only RBAC + automated smoke after rollouts; include playbook step to fallback to cached registry. Due: 2026-03-29. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4722
3) Satish - vendor logs access: negotiate POA + SSO read window with cloud-vendor, escalate to vendor-ops if no response by 2026-03-26. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4723
4) Mike - customer comms template & impacted-customer list; coordinate with legal. Due: 2026-03-28.

Giorgio: Acknowledged. I'll run the drill this week, will include the new autoscaler config in the run and attach perf graphs to INF-4721. Expecting results by Fri. :white_check_mark:

Anya: INF-4722 created, added initial RBAC policy + smoke test hook. Small blocker: need CI runner with model-registry creds for smoke; will request ephemeral creds from infra. Punted to today.

Satish: Vendor asked for signed POA for log access. I'm drafting POA now and loop in procurement. If vendor stalls, I'll open an escalation with our vendor-ops contact (cc @Giorgio). ETA for signed POA: Fri COB.

Mike: I'll draft the comms template and a short FAQ. Can Karma (legal) review by Thu? Also: confirm list of customers using private model-registry endpoint so CS knows who to prioritize.

IncidentBot: Scheduled a monthly "Vendor dependency resilience" drill the first Tuesday of each month starting 2026-04-07. I've added a calendar invite for participants above and set a reminder 48h prior.

Emma: Two follow-ups: (a) Giorgio—please include a note about the cold-start percentiles we want to meet (p50/p90/p99) in INF-4721; (b) Satish—if POA isn't signed by Thu EOD, we escalate per the vendor SLA ladder and open a short-term log-shipper workaround.

Giorgio: Added latency targets to INF-4721: p50 < 120ms, p90 < 400ms, p99 < 1.2s for cold-start across azs. I'll also attach a script to replay traffic.

Satish: Noted. If no POA by Thu EOD, I'll open the escalation and start the log-shipper plan (INF-4724). Will update INF-4723 with progress.

Anya: CI runner request submitted (infra ticket: INF-4725). If infra can't provision ephemeral creds, we have a fallback to run smoke tests against a snapshot registry in staging.

Emma: Great. Let's treat this as the single source of truth for owners and dates. Please update your ticket with short status every 48h until closed. I'll do a check-in on Mon.

Mike: Will update CS playbook and ping legal.

Emma: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks you, ping me directly. :pray:
